scope: Point-cost identity: each site cost entry (weapon, slot, site id) and the Attachment_* record(s) whose Field_6ee865a5 holds its cost. Identity only; costs are read from the capture by scripts/frosty-point-costs.py. Slots: muzzle, barrel, grip, laser, light, ergo, sight (individual optics and iron), mag, ammo. Accessories are not here: frosty-attachment-compatibility.py checks their cost.
method: Reviewed rows are copied from the files in 'sources'. Rows with basis 'chain 2026-11-10' were built for site entries those files lack: a record on the weapon (record -> U_PRG -> ability branch -> U_WPM unlocks, read on 2.1.2.0 by IGC-avail/scan_all.json) whose selector set equals the selector set of the same site id on a reviewed weapon; brand-new site ids take the anchor package named in the row; 'elimination' rows are the only unmapped site entry and the only unused, live, equipped record of that slot's AttachmentCategory on the weapon. Builder: reports/weapon-analyzer-research/2026-11-10-update-2120-post/GEN-costs/build_mapping.py (datamining folder).
